original.target_description: p. 215 Table 2 has two affected-versus-control PBGD genotype-frequency tests: ApaLI and BstNI. The assigned description does not identify which polymorphism/test is intended.

notes: Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; unassigned fields are placeholders. Target ambiguous: PBGD ApaLI affected-versus-control chi-square = 6.67, P < 0.01; PBGD BstNI affected-versus-control chi-square = 1.39, P = 0.50. Both fit the generic PBGD association description and p. 215 Table 2 locator. No selection by row order or numeric matching. Candidate participant Ns: ApaLI (6 + 29 + 18) + (16 + 24 + 11) = 53 + 51 = 104; BstNI (16 + 27 + 9) + (19 + 27 + 5) = 52 + 51 = 103. These are final mutually exclusive genotype counts, with generic unusable-allele exclusions described p. 214, and distinct from recruitment N = 106. Neither candidate is assigned to the unresolved target. Table also contains within-group Hardy-Weinberg tests; those test equilibrium rather than disease association and are not substitutes. PDF p. 215 visually inspected.
